original_question: Soundararajan proved the lower bound I3(T) >= (20.26 a3 / 9!) (1 + o(1)) T (log T)^9 for sufficiently large T. Improve the constant 20.26, ideally all the way to the conjecturally best value 42, and likewise improve the corresponding lower-bound constants for Ik(T) when k > 3.
target_in_paper: Problem (6) under "Moments of the Riemann zeta function" in the PROBLEMS section: improve Soundararajan’s lower-bound constant for I3(T), with the added parenthetical request to likewise improve the lower bounds for Ik(T) when k > 3. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2405.17800))
correct_elements: Your draft is already very close to the paper’s official formulation: it correctly identifies Soundararajan’s lower bound for I3(T), the numerical constant 20.26, the target value 42, and the paper’s parenthetical extension to Ik(T) for k > 3. In substance, it is essentially a paraphrase of Problem (6). ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2405.17800))
missing_details: I3(T) and Ik(T) should be defined explicitly as Ik(T) = ∫0^T |ζ(1/2 + it)|^(2k) dt. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2405.17800))

The arithmetic factor a3 should be identified as the k = 3 specialization of the paper’s factor ak, where ak = ∏p ((1 - p^(-1))^(k^2) Σm≥0 (Γ(m+k)/(m!Γ(k)))^2 p^(-m)). ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2405.17800))
The asymptotic variable should be made explicit: the statement is about T → ∞, equivalently a bound holding for all sufficiently large T. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2405.17800))

The phrase "best possible value 42" is implicit unless one ties it to the paper’s moment-constant discussion; in the paper’s notation, it matches the k = 3 conjectural leading constant coming from Ck in the introduction. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2405.17800))

To be fully stand-alone, the higher-k clause should say that one seeks analogous improvements for the leading numerical constants in lower bounds for Ik(T) of the expected order T(log T)^(k^2), rather than leaving "corresponding lower-bound constants" implicit. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2405.17800))
refined_question: Let Ik(T) := ∫0^T |ζ(1/2 + it)|^(2k) dt for k ≥ 0, and let ak := ∏p ((1 - p^(-1))^(k^2) Σm=0^∞ (Γ(m+k)/(m!Γ(k)))^2 p^(-m)). Soundararajan proved that, as T → ∞, I3(T) ≥ (20.26 a3 / 9!)(1 + o(1)) T (log T)^9. Can one improve the numerical constant 20.26 in this sixth-moment lower bound, ideally up to the paper’s stated best possible value 42, and likewise improve the leading numerical constants in analogous lower bounds for Ik(T) for fixed k > 3? ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2405.17800))
justification: The draft is targeting Problem (6) directly, and that problem is the nearest official formulation in the paper. The only substantive work needed is to make the question self-contained by importing the paper’s notation Ik(T) from the NOTATION section and the arithmetic factor ak from the Introduction. I did not broaden the problem beyond the paper’s wording; in particular, I kept the focus on improving the lower-bound constants for zeta moments, with the sixth moment as the primary case and the k > 3 extension only as stated parenthetically in Problem (6). ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2405.17800))
